method_change: rebuild upper assembly from actual v17 bomber first, then reintegrate approved R2 elements
prompt:
Use case: mecha concept refinement. One single coherent WAIST-UP mechanical key-art concept of Social Brave King / 社勇王 in a strong front three-quarter view, landscape 1536x1024, plain warm ivory background, no labels, no graphic effects.

Reference hierarchy is important. Image 1 v17 is the PRIMARY upper-body architecture reference: an entire bomber airframe sits over the torso, its wide swept wings and thick central fuselage creating a powerful horizontal upper-body frame. Image 2 is the SAME standalone bomber that must remain recognizable in that assembly: broad continuous flying-wing center-body, one faceted glazed cockpit with an orange wedge nose, both substantial swept wings, strong wing roots, engine nacelles, upper intake openings. Image 3 is the current R2 combined form: keep its approved orange/ivory cel drawing language, enlarged PHYSICAL armored fists/forearms, long orange-white mane, train-half-shell arm attachments and established body identity. Its thin chest and tiny train-like shoulder winglets are the exact defects to replace. Image 4 is the uncombined Brave Fist core robot: only use it to make the combined head visibly UPGRADED, never merely repeat the same helmet.

REBUILD the upper body from the v17 bomber component, rather than decorating the narrow R2 chest. The complete bomber's broad center fuselage rests over a thick barrel chest and shoulders, like a heavy aircraft mantle. A single bomber cockpit/nose forms the forward central chest, connected to a WIDE deep fuselage deck that runs behind the neck into the upper back. Its strong swept wings extend to BOTH sides, their wide aerodynamic surfaces and aft wing portions clearly visible beyond the shoulders and behind the arms. Show real wing area, trailing-edge/control surface panels and visible substantial roots, not two thin spikes, not train carriage cabins, no rectangular passenger windows. Keep the bomber component readable as an aircraft with its own coherent structural frame even when attached. Pair of upper-airframe intakes/engine housings sit visibly inboard of the wing roots; do not replace the pre-existing fists with aircraft engines.

The core torso underneath must also be visibly beefier: broad ribcage, deep chest sides, stout abdominal armor and a strong waist block. Increase chest/upper-abdomen mass roughly 25-30% from R2, retain a humanoid waist and allow shoulders/elbows to articulate; no skinny exposed wasp waist, no additional duplicate cockpit noses.

UPGRADE THE COMBINED HEAD. Keep the core's orange-white mane and cyan eye identity, but give the combined form a more commanding v17-like helmet with broad silver cheek/temple armor, a larger central orange crest inset, layered angular crown plates and a clearly expanded symmetrical jagged silver/orange corona that rises from the added helmet frame. The silhouette must be more complex and wider than the core's simple twin horns. This is a designed new combined helmet, not just adding extra long antenna wires. Clean closed armored lower face, NO Gundam mouth slits or iconic red chin. Avoid an organic lion head or toy mascot face. Mechanical fierce heroic expression.

Both actual giant clenched fists must remain strongly visible and fully attached through short stout wrist joints to thick forearms. Split undersea-train half-shells remain OUTSIDE the forearm reinforcements, their cab ends toward the elbows/rear and lateral openings toward the fists, not on the shoulders or chest. Preserve massive real knuckles, fingers and thumbs; no glowing circles masking them. Show hip/waist in the bottom of the composition so the thicker torso can be judged. Fit both complete swept wing tips, crown and both hands inside frame.

Rendering must match image 3's accepted hand-drawn KINETIC_CEL style, not image 1/2's 3D render. Bold clean designed linework, crisp orange/ivory/graphite color planes with a single hard shadow band, cyan only in eyes/tiny emitters. Minimal weathering. Clear component ownership and mechanical assembly. ONE robot, no exploded collage, no extra machines.
